audit.report: The fraud model rescore batch job (pid 1297839) entered an idle-in-transaction state holding locks that blocked 12 checkout sessions, collapsing checkout success from 82% to 0% with $18,400/min revenue at risk. The Database Guardian proposed terminating the blocker, citing its replayable nature (240-minute replay cost) and trade-off analysis showing waiting would cost ~$4.4M over the remaining ~4-hour runtime. The Continuity Guardian accepted after confirming the termination would release locks on waiting checkout sessions. The authority authorized the termination, which completed in 145.3 seconds. Post-termination verification confirmed full recovery: 100% checkout success over 10 seconds, no lock waits, and no protected settlements affected.
audit.root_cause: The batch_replayable_fraud_model_rescore job (pid 1297839) became idle in transaction for 4.2 seconds with a trivial "SELECT 1" statement, holding locks that blocked all checkout sessions.
lessons: For batch_replayable_fraud_model_rescore: add a transaction timeout or idle-in-transaction guard to prevent a single stalled worker from blocking checkout for the full 4-hour replay window.
For batch_replayable_fraud_model_rescore: instrument the job to emit progress heartbeats so the detector can distinguish "slow but progressing" from "stuck idle" before checkout collapses to 0%.

For batch_replayable_fraud_model_rescore: pre-register the 240-minute replay cost and may_interrupt policy in the workload registry so future negotiations can skip the probe round and decide in one step.
audit.negotiation_critique: The Database Guardian efficiently gathered all required evidence (workload registry, protected settlements, change calendar, business impact) in a single round and the Continuity Guardian accepted without objection, resulting in a clean one-round pact.
follow_ups: Add pg_idle_in_transaction_session_timeout or application-level heartbeat to batch_replayable_fraud_model_rescore to auto-terminate stalled workers.
Verify the 240-minute replay cost estimate with risk-ml team and document the exact replay procedure.
Review all BATCH_REPLAYABLE workloads for similar idle-in-transaction risk and apply consistent guards.
